"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>静态靠对称，动态靠半电路</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>标准长尾差分：先求尾电流并均分；差模单端输出时，再按单端差模关系求增益。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>求尾电流 → 对称均分 → 求 Q → 画差模半电路 → 求单端差模增益</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>单端输出与双端输出的增益关系不要混。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>静态先求尾电流再对称均分；动态若是单端差模输出，再检查是否需要那个 1/2。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">I<sub>C1</sub>=I<sub>C2</sub>≈0.5 mA，U<sub>C1</sub>=U<sub>C2</sub>≈3.45 V，r<sub>be</sub>≈2.952 kΩ，A<sub>ud,单</sub>≈−12.87。</span></p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2019–2020 B卷 · 第5题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">差动</span><span class="tag">双端输出</span><span class="tag">静态</span><span class="tag">A<sub>ud</sub></span></div></div><div class="score">10 分 · 双端模板</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2019-2020 B卷 第5题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>先看输出方式：双端就别再乘 1/2</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>静态分析不变；动态部分的关键是认清“双端输出”，再写对应的差模增益。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>求 Q → 算 r_be → 确认双端输出 → 写双端差模增益</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>单/双端是这题公式差异的第一检查点。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>先看清是双端输出：双端差模增益不要再多乘 1/2，这是本题最直接的得分开关。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">I<sub>BQ</sub>≈1 μA，I<sub>CQ</sub>≈0.1 mA，U<sub>CEQ</sub>≈9.6 V，r<sub>be</sub>≈26.5 kΩ，A<sub>ud,双</sub>≈−109.1。</span></p></div></details></div></div></article>
